title: Surface protective_stop/profit_target on the positions table and stock detail page
description: The backend already computes protective_stop and profit_target, but they're not visible where a user would naturally look: PositionsTable.tsx (the primary 'what do I own' view) has no stop/target columns at all -- both only exist in the separate RiskPanel further down the page. StockDetailPage.tsx has zero position-awareness -- viewing a ticker you actually hold shows the same generic analysis as any other ticker, with no 'you're in this at $X, your stop is $Y' context.

checklist.step: Add protective_stop and profit_target columns to PositionsTable.
Add a 'you hold this position' context panel/banner to the stock detail page when the viewed ticker is in the user's portfolio, showing entry price, current stop, and target.
Component tests for both surfaces, including the no-position case on the stock detail page (banner correctly absent).
